cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
for i in $(seq 1 8); do grep -q 'video_render_' scripts/make_video.py && break; sleep 8; done
grep -c 'video_render_' scripts/make_video.py; grep -c modelBadge video_gemini.html
echo tracked-before: $(git ls-files data/blocks_gemini/tmp data/blocks/tmp | wc -l)
(
flock -w 120 9 || { echo no-lock; exit 1; }
git rm -r -q --cached --ignore-unmatch data/blocks_gemini/tmp data/blocks/tmp
git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l
git commit -q -m "vps: untrack stale render tmp (loop frames)" && echo committed
for a in 1 2 3; do git push -q 2>/dev/null && { echo push-ok; break; }; git fetch -q origin main --depth 30 --update-shallow; git rebase -q --autostash origin/main || git rebase --abort; sleep 4; done
) 9>/tmp/vps_git.lock
echo tracked-after: $(git ls-files data/blocks_gemini/tmp data/blocks/tmp | wc -l)
rm -rf data/blocks_gemini/tmp data/blocks/tmp
cat > /tmp/manual_video2.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo || exit 1
echo "=== start $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 1500 /usr/bin/python3 scripts/make_video.py gemini 2>&1 | iconv -c -f utf-8 -t utf-8 | grep -v 'DeprecationWarning\|now_utc\|utcnow'
echo "video rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]} $(date -u +%T)"
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import vps_ai_pipeline as v
v.git_push_ai()
PY
echo "=== done $(date -u +%T)"
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/manual_video2.sh
nohup flock /tmp/vps_ai_pipeline.lock bash /tmp/manual_video2.sh > /tmp/manual_video2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1; echo launched; date -u
